Questions

Before you book

How early should I book my date?

Book as early as you can, especially for the wedding season. Dates are confirmed with an advance.

Is the trial included?

One trial is included in Signature and two in Royal. In Classic it is an optional paid add-on.

Can you come to the wedding venue?

Yes, venue service is available on request. Share the location and time when you message us.

How long will my bridal look last?

We use a long-wear base and set it for the day, so it holds through the rituals and photos. A touch-up kit is included in Signature and Royal.

What are the advance and cancellation terms?

Share your policy here, for example the advance amount and the cancellation window.
